description: eu07/maszyna#525, Baltyk skm1, the mission that starts on the siding of Baltyk Towarowy next to the shunter (EN90-009A, ROJ55324): the station lets the unit into the platforms once its shunter 6Dg-1244, on the track beside it, has done its first moves (4 minutes after the start), and out to Alakowice at 10:42. A shunter that gets stuck leaves the unit at the shunting signal for good: standing for 15 minutes ends the test as standstill.
